name: EXEC - Proactive Open Loop Resurfacing

parameters.query:
WITH reminders AS (

  SELECT
    id::text AS issue_uuid,
    title,
    item_type,
    priority,
    description,
    next_action,
    waiting_on,
    assigned_to,
    municipality,
    decision_options,
    recommendation,
    'DUE'::text AS reminder_type,
    due_at AS reminder_at,
    to_char(
      now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
      'YYYY-MM-DD'
    ) AS reminder_day
  FROM issues
  WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')
    AND due_at IS NOT NULL
    AND due_at <= now()

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    id::text,
    title,
    item_type,
    priority,
    description,
    next_action,
    waiting_on,
    assigned_to,
    municipality,
    decision_options,
    recommendation,
    'FOLLOW_UP'::text,
    follow_up_at,
    to_char(
      now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
      'YYYY-MM-DD'
    )
  FROM issues
  WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')
    AND follow_up_at IS NOT NULL
    AND follow_up_at <= now()

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    id::text,
    title,
    item_type,
    priority,
    description,
    next_action,
    waiting_on,
    assigned_to,
    municipality,
    decision_options,
    recommendation,
    'DECISION'::text,
    decision_by,
    to_char(
      now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
      'YYYY-MM-DD'
    )
  FROM issues
  WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')
    AND item_type = 'DECISION'
    AND decision_by IS NOT NULL
    AND decision_by <= now()
    AND (
      NULLIF(trim(decision_outcome), '') IS NULL
      OR upper(trim(decision_outcome)) = 'PENDING'
    )
)

SELECT *
FROM reminders
WHERE (
  EXTRACT(
    HOUR FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
  ) BETWEEN 7 AND 21
  OR title IN (
    'CMOS EA Push Test',
    'CMOS Decision Push Test'
  )
)
ORDER BY reminder_at, priority DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO alerts (schema_version, alert_id, source, source_event_id, category, subtype, status, event_action, title, message, priority, county, municipality, location, tags, click_url, source_url, observed_at, source_updated_at, received_at, expires_at, metadata, raw_payload, search_text, updated_at) SELECT COALESCE(j->>'schema_version','1.0'), j->>'alert_id', j->>'source', NULLIF(j->>'source_event_id',''), j->>'category', j->>'subtype', j->>'status', j->>'event_action', j->>'title', j->>'message', (j->>'priority')::integer, NULLIF(j->>'county',''), NULLIF(j->>'municipality',''), COALESCE(j->'location','{}'::jsonb), ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j->'tags','[]'::jsonb))), NULLIF(j->>'click_url',''), NULLIF(j->>'source_url',''), NULLIF(j->>'observed_at','')::timestamptz, NULLIF(j->>'source_updated_at','')::timestamptz, COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'received_at','')::timestamptz,NOW()), NULLIF(j->>'expires_at','')::timestamptz, COALESCE(j->'metadata','{}'::jsonb), j, NULLIF(j->>'search_text',''), NOW() FROM d ON CONFLICT (alert_id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status, event_action=EXCLUDED.event_action, title=EXCLUDED.title, message=EXCLUDED.message, priority=EXCLUDED.priority, county=EXCLUDED.county, municipality=EXCLUDED.municipality, location=EXCLUDED.location, tags=EXCLUDED.tags, click_url=EXCLUDED.click_url, metadata=EXCLUDED.metadata, raw_payload=EXCLUDED.raw_payload, search_text=EXCLUDED.search_text, updated_at=NOW() RETURNING id::text AS alert_db_uuid ) SELECT d.j AS alert, upserted.alert_db_uuid FROM d CROSS JOIN upserted;
